# LORE BTC Context Brief — Template

*Generated by `tools/lore/research_context.py`. Paste into mentor chat before chart review.*
*Replace all [bracketed] values with actual data from the scripts.*

---

## Price / OHLCV
- Timeframe: [4h / 1h / 1d]
- Last close: **[$X]**
- Last high: [$H] | Last low: [$L]
- Candle timestamp: [YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC]

## Funding Rate
- Current: **[+0.00X% / -0.00X%]** — [POSITIVE / NEGATIVE / NEUTRAL]
- Trend: [rising / falling / flat]

> Interpretation: [e.g. "Slightly elevated positive funding — market paying longs. Not extreme yet."]

## Open Interest
- Trend: **[EXPANDING / CONTRACTING / FLAT]** ([+X.X% / -X.X%] over lookback)
- Level: [$XB]

> Interpretation: [e.g. "OI expanding as price falls = shorts building / longs adding into drop"]

## Liquidation Clusters
- Long clusters (above price): [$X at $Y magnitude], [$X2 at $Y2 magnitude]
- Short clusters (below price): [$X at $Y magnitude], [$X2 at $Y2 magnitude]

> **Untaken clusters = price magnets.** Nearest untaken: [long at $X / short at $Y]

## Volatility Regime
- Current: **[trending_low_vol / trending_high_vol / ranging / choppy]**
- Regime guidance: [copy from fetch_regime.py output]

---

## Matched Controls (from research_setup.py)

- Setup queried: [range_low_sweep / wick_fill / etc.]
- Conditions: funding=[negative/positive], OI=[expanding/contracting]
- **N (sample size): [X]**
- **Win rate: [X%]**
- **Median forward return 24h: [+X%]**
- **Median forward return 48h: [+X%]**
- **Max adverse excursion (MAE): [X%]** ← stop beyond this
- **vs Matched Control: [+X%]** ← positive = real edge

## How The Mentor Uses This Brief

| LORE field | Goes into section |
|---|---|
| Regime | Section 1 (Current Market Structure) |
| Funding + OI | Section 2 (What Matches) + Section 3 (Missing) |
| Liquidation clusters | Section 3 (What Is Still Missing) |
| MAE | Section 4 (Exact Conditions) + Section 5 (Risk) |
| N + win rate + forward returns | Section 5 (Risk Management & Targets) |
| Edge vs control | Section 7 (Final Recommendation confidence) |
